Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production app icon for CrossMux e-paper reader, the LIBRARY app.
Subject: a compact group of three upright hardcover books on a short shelf, one gently leaning, with a tiny ribbon bookmark. Clear library/bookshelf meaning.
Design a refined cohesive icon system: softly rounded flat editorial illustration, a small amount of geometric depth, NOT a glossy 3D render. Bold deep ink contours, large simple color regions, a very restrained two-tone shadow inside shapes. Rich muted teal, warm ochre, and cream page edges with dark ink outlines. Shape and luminance must carry recognition even after conversion to 2-level black/white; no two touching regions distinguished only by hue. Strong readable outer silhouette, generous open white/light spaces, minimal details suitable for 32px. All contour strokes about 3% of object width.
Composition: one centered isolated object group, square canvas, object occupies 76-80% of width and height, generous clean transparent padding on all sides. Front three-quarter perspective with only shallow depth. Crisp edges. No enclosing app tile, no background plate, no drop shadow outside the object, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Output high resolution square color master, not a sprite sheet.
